description: Source code for subgraph rewriting in PyTorch JIT, including pattern registration, matching, and graph rewriting functions.

classes.name: SubgraphRewriter
classes.description: Class responsible for registering patterns and performing subgraph rewrites in TorchScript graphs.

methods.name: RegisterDefaultPatterns
methods.description: Registers default pattern-replacement pairs for common subgraph patterns.

methods.name: RegisterRewritePattern
methods.description: Registers a custom pattern and its replacement with associated value mappings.

methods.name: runOnModule
methods.description: Applies pattern-based rewriting to all methods within a module.

methods.name: runOnGraph
methods.description: Performs pattern matching and rewriting on a specific graph.

methods.name: rewriteSinglePatternOnGraph
methods.description: Rewrites occurrences of a specific pattern within a graph.

methods.name: overlapsWithPreviousMatches
methods.description: Checks if a match overlaps with previously matched nodes scheduled for deletion.
